verdict.rationale: LegalZoom's registered-agent page publishes a flat price of "$249/year — Auto renews. Cancel anytime". Its renewal footnote says the service "auto-renews at the purchase rate each year until you cancel," so the renewal price is stated up front. Two caveats weaken the guarantee: the page says "the renewal rate is subject to change," and the purchase price is limited to first-time registered-agent customers. missing for 10: a locked or guaranteed renewal price (not one 'subject to change'), a stated price for returning customers, and independent or hands-on confirmation of actual renewal charges.
